versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: At the start of the game, add Create a Machine to your hand.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: At the start of the game, if you have Ultimathrash in your hand or deck, transform it into Failed Design to add all other Thrashing Parts into your deck and replace this artifact with the Ultimate Fusion artifact. Otherwise, add Create a Machine to your hand and deck.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: At the start of the game, burn an ally Ultimathrash wherever it is. Draw a card if it's in your hand. Transform into the Ultimate Fusion artifact. Otherwise, add Create a Machine to your hand and deck.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: The first time your hand is empty after playing a card, add all Thrashing Parts to your hand and disable this. If you have Ultimathrash at the start of the game, burn it wherever it is, draw a card if it's in hand, and transform into Ultimate Fusion.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: The first time your hand is empty after playing a card, add all Thrashing Parts to your hand and disable this. If you have Ultimathrash at the start of the game, transform into Ultimate Fusion.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: The first time your hand is empty after playing a card, add all Thrashing Parts to your hand with -1 cost and disable this. If you have Ultimathrash at the start of the game, transform into Ultimate Fusion.

versions.name: Evil Plan
versions.text: The first time your hand is empty after playing a card, add all Thrashing Parts to your hand with +1 ATK and disable this. If you have Ultimathrash at the start of the game, transform into Ultimate Fusion.
